chapter_seo_title: Han Li Captures Four Cultivators Alive – Chapter 302 Reveals Sinister Conspiracy
chapter_meta_description: Han Li uses his puppets to capture four fleeing cultivators alive. But a chilling conversation at the scene reveals they were disposable pawns in a larger demonic sect plot.
og_description: Han Li effortlessly captures four fleeing Qi Condensation cultivators. The scene reveals a chilling demonic sect conspiracy.
twitter_title: Ch. 302: When you use disposable puppets... literally.
twitter_description: Han Li’s puppet tactics are flawless, but the real story is at the empty crime scene. A secret sect is already covering its tracks.

lore_anchors.definition: A cultivator at the second major realm, possessing vastly superior magical power, lifespan, and tactical options compared to Qi Condensation cultivators.
Soul-controlled, inanimate constructs that can be armed with weapons and follow complex tactical commands; a hallmark of Han Li’s Thousand Bamboo School legacy.
A speed-oriented flying artifact crafted from Ink Flood Dragon materials; it is fast but lacks defensive capabilities.
A dark ritual placed on a subordinate’s body that allows a master to inflict lethal punishment or trigger a pre-determined death remotely.
A classical Chinese stratagem where one creates a decoy or a visible front to mask a true, covert movement or transformation.
The vital source of a cultivator’s life and magical power; forcibly draining it is a ruthless act of resource theft.
